about: Meaford is a municipality on Georgian Bay in Grey County, Ontario, combining the harbour town of Meaford with surrounding countryside—not a large city. Apple country, a working harbour, and Niagara Escarpment approaches toward the Blue Mountains define the community. About 11,000 people live in Meaford.
